Both paths get people hired. They lead to different kinds of roles.

Deep frontend leads to specialist roles: performance, design systems, complex UIs.
Full-stack opens more doors at startups, where one person often owns a feature end to end.

What would you pick, and what are you basing it on: job listings, your college, or what you enjoy building?
